sentences.en: WOMAN: It's really good to see you, Tom
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 很高兴见到你，汤姆。

sentences.en: Since I had to give up work, I feel I'm losing touch with my friends and colleagues
sentences.zh: 自从我不得不辞职以来，我觉得自己正逐渐与朋友和同事失去联系。

sentences.en: MAN: We really miss you in the office
sentences.zh: MAN: 办公室里大家都非常想念你。

sentences.en: We were all so sorry you had to leave
sentences.zh: 我们都很遗憾你不得不离开。

sentences.en: But you must be relieved to have more time to look after your mother
sentences.zh: 但你一定很欣慰现在有更多时间照顾你母亲了。

sentences.en: How is she?
sentences.zh: 她最近怎么样？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Well she is very cheerful, but she needs a lot of help
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 她心情非常愉快，但需要大量帮助。

sentences.en: MAN: Have you tried to get any support from the local council?
sentences.zh: MAN: 你有没有尝试向当地议会申请任何支持？

sentences.en: WOMAN: No, I didn't know I could
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 没有，我之前并不知道我可以这么做。

sentences.en: MAN: Yes, they offer different kinds of practical support
sentences.zh: MAN: 是的，他们提供多种实用支持。

sentences.en: They realise that carers sometimes need time for all the other responsibilities they have, apart from the person they're caring for, and also that they sometimes need a break
sentences.zh: 他们意识到照护者有时需要腾出时间来处理除照护对象之外的其他责任，同时也意识到照护者有时也需要休息。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Absolutely
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 完全正确。

sentences.en: OK, so tell me more
sentences.zh: 好的，那请再详细告诉我一些情况。

sentences.en: How do I go about getting this support?
sentences.zh: 我该如何申请这种支持呢？

sentences.en: MAN: Well, you'd have to have an assessment of your mother's needs
sentences.zh: MAN: 首先，你需要对你母亲的需求进行一次评估。

sentences.en: That means someone would come round and talk to you about the situation and what you need
sentences.zh: 这意味着会有人上门拜访，与你讨论当前的情况以及你的具体需求。

sentences.en: So, for a start, they'd want to know the amount of time you spend looking after your mother every day
sentences.zh: 因此，首先他们会想了解你每天花多少时间照护你母亲。

sentences.en: WOMAN: OK
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: MAN: Then they'll probably ask you what sorts of tasks you do for your mother during the day
sentences.zh: MAN: 然后他们很可能还会问你白天为你母亲做哪些事情。

sentences.en: Things like if she needs help with getting dressed, for example
sentences.zh: 比如，她是否需要你在穿衣方面提供帮助，等等。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Right
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 明白了。

sentences.en: I help her with that
sentences.zh: 我帮她做那件事。

sentences.en: And also I help her get into the shower in the morning
sentences.zh: 另外，早上我还帮她进入淋浴间。

sentences.en: MAN: Yes, that sort of thing
sentences.zh: MAN: 对，就是这类事情。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes, that's becoming a bit of a problem
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的，这正逐渐成为一个问题。

sentences.en: She used to be very good at it, but not anymore
sentences.zh: 她以前在这方面做得很好，但现在不行了。

sentences.en: MAN: And be ready to tell them about anything you find particularly difficult about caring for your mother
sentences.zh: MAN: 并准备好向他们说明你在照顾母亲过程中遇到的任何特别困难之处。

sentences.en: WOMAN: So, recently I've noticed she's started to have quite bad problems with her memory
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 所以，最近我注意到她的记忆力开始出现相当严重的问题。

sentences.en: If I wasn't there, I think she'd forget to eat, for example
sentences.zh: 如果我不在那儿，我想她甚至会忘记吃饭，例如。

sentences.en: And often she doesn't seem quite sure what day it is
sentences.zh: 而且她常常不太确定今天是星期几。

sentences.en: MAN: Yes, tell them about that
sentences.zh: MAN: 是的，把这一点告诉他们。

sentences.en: And are there any physical difficulties you have caring for her?
sentences.zh: 你在照顾她时是否存在任何身体上的困难？

sentences.en: Lifting her, for example?
sentences.zh: 比如抱起她？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes, she's quite heavy and I'm afraid of hurting my back
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的，她体重很重，我担心会伤到自己的背部。

sentences.en: I'd be in real trouble if that happened
sentences.zh: 如果真发生这种情况，我可就麻烦大了。

sentences.en: MAN: They can give you advice about that and also about how to avoid the possibility of your mum having a fall
sentences.zh: MAN: 他们可以就此给你提供建议，同时也会就如何避免你母亲跌倒提供指导。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Great
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 太好了。

sentences.en: So once they've done this assessment, if I'm eligible, what happens next?
sentences.zh: 那么，等他们完成这项评估后，如果我符合条件，接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: MAN: Well, they might support you financially
sentences.zh: MAN: 嗯，他们可能会在经济上给予你支持。

sentences.en: So they might help you with transport costs, like if you have to get a taxi to take your mother for an appointment, for example
sentences.zh: 例如，他们可能帮你承担交通费用——比如你必须打出租车带母亲去就诊时。

sentences.en: WOMAN: I usually drive her myself, actually
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 实际上，我通常都是自己开车送她。

sentences.en: So, could I claim the petrol?
sentences.zh: 那么，我可以报销汽油费吗？

sentences.en: MAN: You could
sentences.zh: MAN: 你可以。

sentences.en: And you can claim for the insurance too
sentences.zh: 而且你也可以报销保险费用。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Oh, right
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦，好的。

sentences.en: MAN: And if you need help with the housework, they can arrange for someone to come along once or twice a week
sentences.zh: MAN: 如果你在家务方面需要帮助，他们可以安排人每周来一两次。

sentences.en: And one other thing
sentences.zh: 还有一件事。

sentences.en: I hope you don't mind me saying this, but it important you look after yourself And it seems to me you under quite a bit of stress
sentences.zh: 我希望你不介意我这么说，但你照顾好自己非常重要；在我看来，你承受的压力相当大。

sentences.en: WOMAN: I am yes
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: MAN: Well tell the council because they may be able to give you some advice on how to minimise it
sentences.zh: MAN: 那么请告诉地方议会，因为他们或许能为你提供一些减轻压力的建议。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Really?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Though, actually, I feel so much better having talked to you
sentences.zh: 不过，实际上，和你聊过之后，我感觉好多了。

sentences.en: I'll get in touch with the council straight away
sentences.zh: 我马上就会联系地方议会。

sentences.en: Now, shall we go for coffee or something?
sentences.zh: 现在，我们去喝杯咖啡之类的东西怎么样？
